text:
Maya: Quick UX nit from usability tests: the tiny 'KMS' badge on Instances makes people think BYOK is enabled by default. :confused:
Sam: Can we make provider + management explicit? e.g. 'AWS KMS · customer-managed' or 'AWS KMS · platform-managed'
Maya: Yes. Also alias vs key id is confusing. Show alias prominently, put full key id behind a disclosure.
Devon: Accessibility: current tooltip is hover-only. We need a keyboard-focusable disclosure (chevron) with aria-expanded and aria-controls so screen readers can access the same info.
Aisha: Security: always show authority (AWS/GCP/Azure) and ownership badge. For customer-managed keys include alias and last rotation in the disclosure.
Sam: UX mock: badge line1 = 'Encryption · AWS KMS' line2 (muted) = 'alias/my-prod-key'. Focus/click opens a small popover with provider, alias, masked key id, last rotation, and copy action.
Oliver: Audit logs inconsistent: we have 'encryption key updated' vs 'KMS key rotated'. Propose canonical: '[actor] [verb] [resource] — from [old] to [new] (ISO tz)'. Verb whitelist: created, attached, detached, rotated, updated, deleted.
Maya: Retention presets labeled 'Short/Default/Long' confuse testers. Quick fix: inline durations 'Short (7d)', 'Default (30d)', 'Long (365d)' and expose durations to screen readers with sr-only text or aria-describedby.
Aisha: MUST: retention changes must log previous_value and actor. Right now audits only show new value which hinders investigations.
Devon: Implementation note: use absolute-positioned popover animated with transform to avoid layout shift in compact lists. Mask key id by default, reveal on explicit copy action.
Sam: Action items: 1) Update badge to 'Encryption (AWS KMS · customer-managed)' + alias. 2) Add keyboard-expand disclosure to reveal masked key id & rotation ts. 3) Show retention durations inline + sr-only labels. 4) Standardize audit verbs and include previous_value for changes.
Maya: I'll update Figma and add accessibility annotations. Filing tickets after mock is uploaded.
